instance.label: moshi-tsukuyomi-m3-voice
instance.selected_for: network speed among offers meeting every hard requirement inside the stop line

host_checks.verified: measured on the instance, not read from the offer
host_checks.why_it_matters: ZeRO-3 + fp16 + AdamW needs 133.94 GB resident for the 8.37B dep_q=16 model, so one 80 GB card is 48 GB short; and finetune.py loads the model on CPU in float32 per rank before partitioning, so too little host RAM OOM-kills at load with no GPU able to help.

offer_search_defect.what: The plan's search filter used gpu_ram>=79.
offer_search_defect.problem: vastai reports gpu_ram in MiB per card, so gpu_ram>=79 matches every GPU ever made. The first qualifying-looking offer was 2x A100 SXM4 with gpu_ram 40960 - 40 GB cards, 80 GB total - which cannot hold the resident state at all.
offer_search_defect.fix: Filter on gpu_ram>=80000 and verify nvidia-smi on the instance before trusting either.
